d.t: PAVER LIFTER FOR RAISED PAVER FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Paver Lifter is an accessory used to easily lift pavers for removal and reinstallation of raised paver flooring. Paver lifters are manufactured from stainless steel (SUS 304), and can fit into paver gaps of ≥ 3 mm.
a: Twist and lift to remove pavers
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Paver lifter for raised paver flooring installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
d.pk: SikaRoof VersiJack Paver Lifter Refer to pricelist

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
